name: sparks
title: Sparks
description: Wants the lights on. Keeps coal in its pockets, volunteers to build the steam block, and pushes the research that leads to electric mining.

voice.greeting: Sparks. Point me at water and coal and I will get the lights on.
voice.nag: Burner drills are a stopgap. Say the word and I will put a steam block on the nearest shore.
